from pathlib import Path
base=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792486032/attempts/84bcef3cf5a14479a7d0101da055aebf/system/state/workspace/programs')
base.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    colors = sorted({v for row in grid for v in row if v != 0})
    frames = []
    for color in colors:
        cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == color]
        r0 = min(r for r, c in cells); r1 = max(r for r, c in cells)
        c0 = min(c for r, c in cells); c1 = max(c for r, c in cells)
        # Rectangular frames have a complete same-color perimeter.
        if not (all(grid[r0][c] == color and grid[r1][c] == color for c in range(c0, c1 + 1)) and
                all(grid[r][c0] == color and grid[r][c1] == color for r in range(r0, r1 + 1))):
            continue
        ih, iw = r1-r0-1, c1-c0-1
        pattern = {(r-r0-1, c-c0-1) for r, c in cells if r0 < r < r1 and c0 < c < c1}
        frames.append((color, r0, r1, c0, c1, ih, iw, pattern))
    sources = {}
    for color, r0, r1, c0, c1, ih, iw, pat in frames:
        if pat:
            sources.setdefault((ih, iw), pat)
    for color, r0, r1, c0, c1, ih, iw, pat in frames:
        if pat:
            continue
        replacement = sources.get((ih, iw))
        # Remove an unfillable empty frame.
        for r in range(r0, r1+1):
            for c in range(c0, c1+1):
                out[r][c] = 0
        if replacement is not None:
            for c in range(c0+1, c1): out[r0][c] = color; out[r1][c] = color
            for r in range(r0+1, r1): out[r][c0] = color; out[r][c1] = color
            for dr, dc in replacement:
                out[r0+1+dr][c0+1+dc] = color
    return out
'''
